title: PRESIDENT OF INDIA PAYS FLORAL TRIBUTES TO SHRI V.V. GIRI ON HIS BIRTH ANNIVERSARY
body_text:
The President of India, Smt Droupadi Murmu paid floral tributes to Shri V.V. Giri, former President of India on his birth anniversary at Rashtrapati Bhavan today (August 10, 2026).
****
MJPS/SS/PRK

enrichment.summary: President Droupadi Murmu paid floral tributes to former President V.V. Giri at Rashtrapati Bhavan on his birth anniversary, observed on 10 August 2026. The event was a ceremonial tribute marking the occasion.
enrichment.context: V.V. Giri (1894-1980) served as the fourth President of India from 1969 to 1974 and was notably the first person to be elected President as an independent candidate, following a contentious election precipitated by a split in the Indian National Congress. He was also a prominent labour leader and trade unionist before entering politics, and earlier served as Governor of several states and as Vice President of India. Such annual tribute ceremonies by the sitting President are customary observances honouring past holders of high constitutional office and do not typically involve policy announcements or exam-relevant developments.
